title: Origin story: Eshu
description: Eshu is the orisha of the crossroads, the divine messenger who carries sacrifices to the gods and reports back. He wears a hat half red, half black, and once walked between two friends — one saw red, one saw black, and they quarreled to blows. He is unpredictability itself, and every rite begins by honoring him.
